 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Mark each missing cell along the boundary of the colored rectangular frame."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (1, 8)]
    if not colors:
        return out
    color = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and grid[r][c] != color:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out

# Verify the demonstration pair: the missing left-side border cell becomes 2.
_demo = [[8] * 29 for _ in range(14)]
for _c in range(1, 14):
    _demo[0][_c] = _demo[12][_c] = 4
for _r in range(1, 13):
    _demo[_r][1] = _demo[_r][13] = 4
_demo[3][1] = 8
_demo_expected = [row[:] for row in _demo]
_demo_expected[3][1] = 2
assert transform(_demo) == _demo_expected
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
